scope: mechanical long-session concurrency diagnostic; no general capacity claim
baseline: same two RTX3090 configuration, Thinker one GPU, Talker/W one GPU, basic 8000/6000

n4.stop_reason: continuing input with all four model-result streams silent >60s, stage0 generation counter flat, KV pool ~99.7%
n4.hardware_inference: consistent with KV capacity blocking progress before per-session window threshold; root cause needs scheduler/allocator confirmation

limitations: one initial diagnostic, manually stopped after sustained lack of progress
model result event is not exact latest consumed input timestamp
no OOM or GPU compute-saturation claim
vLLM idle running/waiting gauges may be stale; conclusion uses continuing input plus output-counter plateau and KV occupancy
3090-specific pool budget; do not extrapolate threshold to H200
N2 sync logger input pauses invalidate strict constant-rate/SLO claims; separate background-writer validation required
